body:
Next session: remaining A1 is PRODUCTION only plus commit/deploy of this session's uncommitted work.

Must deploy worker shared-inbox MTA-sign fix (apps/workers/src/index.ts) or send/reply from agents.*/inbox.* will throw 'not a verified sending domain'.

Then: shared-inbox-dns.sh → setup-shared-inbox-mta.sh on hub → clear 67 failed send jobs → git push hostssh main → dogfood create/receive/reply.

inbox.electronicmailservices.com MX already live. agents.electronicmailservices.com empty. Apex MX = Google, never touch.

API / must stay JSON. Working tree also has unrelated Wave 1 leftovers — do not bundle into the A1 commit.

Quality already green: pnpm test, typecheck 11/11.
